It cites specific metrics (PSNR 22.14 / MS-SSIM 0.836) for the Tanks and Temples/Barn dataset with $m_c=4096$. The provided evidence from Source [S21] explicitly confirms: 1) $m_p$ and $m_c$ definitions, 2) the evaluation of ratios including $m_c/2$, 3) the rationale of trading off performance and computational efficiency, 4) the selection of $m_p = m_c/2$ as the optimal trade-off, and 5) the exact metrics (PSNR 22.14 / MS-SSIM 0.836) for $m_c=4096$ and $m_p=m_c/2$ in Table S1. All facts in the claim are present and supported by the evidence.
